description: Defines the QuicConnectionId class and related constants and enums for managing QUIC connection identifiers, including creation, comparison, serialization, and hashing.

classes.name: quic::QuicConnectionId
classes.description: Represents a QUIC connection ID with methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and modification.

classes.name: quic::QuicConnectionIdHash
classes.description: Hash functor for QuicConnectionId objects, suitable for use in hash tables.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId
methods.description: Default constructor, creates a zero-length connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId
methods.description: Constructs a connection ID from raw bytes or a span.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying connection IDs.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the connection ID in bytes.

methods.name: set_length
methods.description: Sets the length of the connection ID, potentially changing internal data location.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the connection ID bytes in network byte order.

methods.name: mutable_data
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the connection ID bytes.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the connection ID has zero length.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the connection ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection ID.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the connection ID to a stream for logging.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison for ordering connection IDs.
